Dad: How did the group prepare the story?
Eva: Leo asked the interview questions.
Dad: Did Jo type the answers?
Eva: No, Jo took notes with a pen. Sam typed the document afterwards.
Dad: What was Ruby’s job?
Eva: Ruby checked the year with her grandfather.
Dad: And Alex?
Eva: Alex read the final story aloud. He did not take a selfie.
Dad: Did anyone choose a new app?
Eva: No, we used what the class already had. Each of us helped with one part.
